narration: Local Kokoro ONNX af_heart, American English; feature-overview narration with measured optional caption cues.
sources: Native 3840×2400 local application recordings covering the major feature families, with one fictional Monsoon Table purchase as the main story. Fresh phone OCR recording in the approved native composition; licensed kitchen bookends and approved signup footage retained. Authentication stays off camera; no production writes or external supplier messages. Reviewed source segments run at no more than 1.5×. This is an overview, not a deep walkthrough of every feature.
